parsed.reason: Both picks are real, named Montreal venues a visiting family can turn up to (Biodôme and Centre des sciences de Montréal), and both are sourced to the venue's own organisation. Neither is a term-based programme. Null prices are correct, and the notes are honest that holiday hours were not confirmed. The Monday-closure caveat is a useful warning because Dec 28 is a Monday. Two problems keep this from a 5. First, the `when` fields lean on hours from autumn pages, plus a 'listing' for the Monday closure; the times are not invented, but they do not confirm opening in the Dec 27–30 window. Second, the age-fit details come from Tourisme Montréal and a third-party guide rather than the venues themselves. There is no invented figure and no aggregator source_name, and two solid picks is a reasonable result for late December.
